mapper.sql: FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_name = ur.role_name AND rp.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT p.*
ORDER BY p.permission_key
